relations.text_en: Administrative agent on its credit agreement

source.label: Alliant Energy 8-K(2025年3月)
source.quote: On March 3, 2025, Alliant Energy Finance, LLC ("AEF"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Alliant Energy Corporation ("Alliant Energy"), entered into a one-year second amended and restated term loan credit agreement (the "Credit Agreement") with U.S. Bank National Association, as administrative agent, and the several lenders party thereto.
